shard.name: Vanilla Minecraft
shard.description: The official Minecraft server software directly provided and maintained by Mojang Studios.
shard.author: Mojang Studios & Midnight Team
shard.installScript:
#!/bin/bash
# Vanilla Minecraft Installation Script for Midnight Panel
set -e
apk add --no-cache curl jq

cd /mnt/server

echo "Fetching Mojang version manifest..."
MANIFEST_URL="https://piston-meta.mojang.com/mc/game/version_manifest_v2.json"

if [ -z "${MINECRAFT_VERSION}" ] || [ "${MINECRAFT_VERSION}" == "latest" ]; then
    MINECRAFT_VERSION=$(curl -s "${MANIFEST_URL}" | jq -r '.latest.release')
fi

echo "Target version: ${MINECRAFT_VERSION}"
VERSION_URL=$(curl -s "${MANIFEST_URL}" | jq -r --arg v "${MINECRAFT_VERSION}" '.versions[] | select(.id == $v) | .url')

if [ -z "${VERSION_URL}" ] || [ "${VERSION_URL}" == "null" ]; then
    echo "Error: Could not find version ${MINECRAFT_VERSION} in Mojang manifest."
    exit 1
fi

echo "Resolving server jar package..."
SERVER_DOWNLOAD_URL=$(curl -s "${VERSION_URL}" | jq -r '.downloads.server.url')

echo "Downloading vanilla server jar from ${SERVER_DOWNLOAD_URL}..."
curl -o "${SERVER_JARFILE}" -fSL "${SERVER_DOWNLOAD_URL}"

echo "Writing eula.txt..."
echo "eula=true" > eula.txt

echo "Vanilla Minecraft installation completed!"
